blockers: claim: Hardcoded channel 0 in build_mode01_request breaks C ABI channel selection - the core module must not assume channel 0 exists or is appropriate for all PIDs; file: core/src/j2534_transport.cpp; quote: build_mode01_request(req, t->chans[0].tx_id, t->poll_pid);

claim: Missing channel index lookup for poll PID creates potential buffer overflow - rx_for_pid result used to index chans array was removed without replacement; file: core/src/j2534_transport.cpp; quote: build_mode01_request(req, t->chans[0].tx_id, t->poll_pid);

claim: sched_mode logic incorrectly ignores poll_pid, causing scheduler to activate even during single-PID polling which violates the documented request mode semantics; file: core/src/j2534_transport.cpp; quote: const bool sched_mode = (t->sched.count > 0);
questions: What is the lifetime guarantee for t->chans array when t->chan_count is 0 but code still accesses t->chans[0]?
How does the removed channel_index_for_rx lookup handle the case where rx_for_pid returns an invalid channel index?
Why is poll_pid validation moved from parse_query to j2534_attach creating potential for late failure after thread start?

Removed backstop check for poll_pid mode with zero channels could allow invalid state to proceed to hardware operations
